text_en: Praise the Lord ! Praise the name of the Lord ; give praise, O servants of the Lord ,
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 上主的众仆请赞颂，请赞颂上主的圣名！

text_en: you that stand in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God.
text_cn: 你们服役于上主圣殿的， 你们侍立在我主前庭的，

text_en: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good; sing to his name, for he is gracious.
text_cn: 请赞颂上主，因为上主是美善的， 歌咏他的名，因他的名是甘甜的。

text_en: For the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel as his own possession.
text_cn: 雅各伯原是上主为自己所选， 以色列永远作他自己的家产。

text_en: For I know that the Lord is great; our Lord is above all gods.
text_cn: 我确切知道，上主伟大无比！ 我们的主宰，超越所有神祇！

text_en: Whatever the Lord pleases he does, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all deeps.
text_cn: 上天下地，海洋深渊的任何化工， 上主只要愿意，无一不由他造成。

text_en: He it is who makes the clouds rise at the end of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
text_cn: 他使云彩由地极现露， 他使电光闪烁而成雨， 他使清风从宝库发出。

text_en: He it was who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both human beings and animals;
text_cn: 他将埃及的人和牲畜， 凡首生者都一起杀戮。

text_en: he sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
text_cn: 埃及！他在你内行了奇迹异能， 惩罚了法郎和他的万众臣民。

text_en: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings—
text_cn: 他击败了列国的万民， 他杀死了强盛的国君：

text_en: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
text_cn: 阿摩黎王息红、巴商王敖格， 以及客纳罕地的王侯官吏。

text_en: and gave their land as a heritage, a heritage to his people Israel.
text_cn: 他将他们的土地变作产业， 赐给了自己的人民以色列。

text_en: Your name, O Lord , endures forever, your renown, O Lord , throughout all ages.
text_cn: 上主，你的圣名千秋留存， 上主，你的记念万世常新。

text_en: For the Lord will vindicate his people, and have compassion on his servants.
text_cn: 因为上主护卫自己的百姓， 对自己的仆人们表示怜悯。

text_en: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
text_cn: 异民的偶像，无非金银， 只是人手中的制造品：

text_en: They have mouths, but they do not speak; they have eyes, but they do not see;
text_cn: 偶像有口，而不能言， 偶像有眼，而不能看，

text_en: they have ears, but they do not hear, and there is no breath in their mouths.
text_cn: 有耳，而听不见， 有鼻，而无气喘。

text_en: Those who make them and all who trust them shall become like them.
text_cn: 铸造偶像的人，将与偶像同亡， 凡信赖偶像的人， 也将是一样。

text_en: O house of Israel, bless the Lord ! O house of Aaron, bless the Lord !
text_cn: 以色列家族，请赞颂上主！ 亚郎家族，也请赞颂上主！

text_en: O house of Levi, bless the Lord ! You that fear the Lord , bless the Lord !
text_cn: 肋未家族，也请赞颂上主！ 敬畏上主的人，赞颂上主！

text_en: Blessed be the Lord from Zion, he who resides in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 住在耶路撒冷的大君， 愿他由熙雍承受赞颂！
